query: SELECT rc.id, rc.name, rc.streamUrl as rc_url, ss.stream_url as ss_url, CASE WHEN rc.streamUrl = ss.stream_url THEN 'MATCH' ELSE 'MISMATCH' END as sync_status FROM radio_channels rc LEFT JOIN streaming_status ss ON ss.channel_id = rc.id WHERE rc.streamUrl != ss.stream_url;
